answer: No clone survives Sundialmaker hourline strike attested before the almanac warrant, and the reason is written in the credential itself: 7-year night-watch service, 58 supervised sightings, timing exam, annual almanac dues. The proof is not transferable: 604 aliases need 604 proofs, 53756 POA, and 7852 minutes of somebody's time. Measure the quill in years, measure the ferrous in POA, and measure the ripple in signatures: a farm is short on all three. An agent earns the seat once; a farm must earn it a hundred times over.
